title: Isaac Mwanza v National Assembly of Zambia, Attorney General and Electoral Commission of Zambia (2024/CCZ/0022) [2025] ZMCC 17 (27 August 2025)
case_name: Isaac Mwanza v National Assembly of Zambia, Attorney General and Electoral Commission of Zambia
issue_tags: Articles 72(2)(c), 72(8) — vacancy in office of Member of Parliament
section 96(1)(b) Electoral Process Act No. 35 of 2016
Standing Order 223 — Standing Orders of the National Assembly 2024
Parliamentary and Ministerial Code of Conduct Act, Chapter 16
National Assembly (Powers and Privileges) Act, Chapter 12
Order IV rule 2 CCR — required content of a petition
outcome_detail: Petition dismissed. The Court held that the Petition is not properly before the Court (failure to comply with Order IV rule 2 of the Constitutional Court Rules — paragraphs 15–33 of the petition were mere surplusage setting out provisions of the law rather than the constitutional provisions allegedly breached; in addition the Petitioner did not plead matters concerning the by-election and so no relief could be granted in respect of relief 'viii'). No order as to costs.
